title: 货叮咚 ERP MCP 连接配置
description: 连接您的货叮咚 ERP 账号。X-Mcp-Key 仅存储在本机，由 WorkBuddy 在连接货叮咚 MCP 服务时通过请求头注入。请勿向他人分享该密钥。
description_en: Connect your Huodingdong ERP account. X-Mcp-Key is stored only on this device and injected into the request header by WorkBuddy when connecting to the Huodingdong MCP service. Do not share this key with others.

fields.label: X-Mcp-Key
fields.placeholder: 在货叮咚「系统 → 开放平台 → MCP管理」页面复制访问密钥
fields.placeholder_en: Copy the access key from System > Open Platform > MCP Management in Huodingdong
fields.description: 密钥与当前货叮咚账号绑定，数据访问范围继承该账号权限；密钥泄露后请立即撤销并重新签发。
fields.description_en: The key is bound to your current Huodingdong account, and data access follows that account's permissions. Revoke and reissue the key immediately if it is exposed.
